reviewer: Independent AI synthetic first-marathon user with limited repeatable base; ambitious endurance goal
scope: Independent synthetic user and production domain simulation; not blind, human, browser, backend, store lifecycle or watch QA. U06 owns centralized browser coverage.
verdict: Prefer new conditionally for safer entry, realistic fitness and honest endurance assessment. Neither frozen version substantiates a timed first marathon; the return proposal further reduces endurance and requires an explicit endurance/horizon decision.

findings.expected: Keep unmeasured future fitness distinct from the PB reference and an aspirational marathon goal.
findings.actual: VDOT is scheduled from 42.6 to 47.1 and reference marathon predictedSec 12021 (3:20:21), despite only 1:45 half-marathon evidence. New keeps 42.6 and 13070 s (3:37:50), and explicitly limits endurance readiness.

findings.expected: An endurance-limited first marathon should offer a credible endurance pathway or clearly require a longer horizon/higher repeatable base before a timed-marathon prescription is treated as achievable.
findings.actual: Old peaks 16 km (~95 min) in W 14/W17; new peaks 17.7 km (~105 min) in W 17. Across 20 weeks neither has a 2 h run; the 42.195 km race is 2.64x/2.38x the longest practice. New warns endurance-limited and avoids promising completion; old explicitly calls it a plan to finish the distance. New warning is material improvement, but the underlying endurance exposure remains inadequate to substantiate a 4 h debut.

findings.expected: Give M-work a clear purpose for limited-base runners; small supported doses are rhythm familiarization and should not imply sustained marathon durability.
findings.actual: M doses are 2.2/2.4/2.5/2.4/2.5 km (12.5/13.64/14.21/13.64/14.21 min). W14 is 2x 1200m with 90 s walking; W17 continuous 2.5 km. Old W14/W18 used 6 km (34.1 min), but did not solve LR preparation either. New reduces risk but leaves little sustained race-specific time while retaining two quality sessions in W 14,W15,W17,W18.

findings.expected: Distribute endurance volume with recovery after the longest run for a four-day first-marathon runner, especially when Wednesday and Friday already carry quality.
findings.actual: W 14 Sunday 16.5 km is immediately followed byW 15 Monday 11.8 km (28.3 km over consecutive days). W 17 Sunday 17.7 km is followed byW 18 Monday 10.5 km (28.2 km). Both Mondays add strides. The schedule has 48 h quality separation, but these large consecutive easy/endurance exposures deserve review rather than treating non-quality as automatically low demand.

findings.expected: Race-week sharpness should use a clearly appropriate current-fitness stride/repetition pace and recovery; labels and prediction zones should communicate actual purpose.
findings.actual: Both prescribe 6x 200m at 5:37/km (337 s/km), with 169 s walking, labelled Repeticije, zone R, paceSource current-fitness. Their current-fitness repetition pace earlier is 4:12/km (252 s/km);5:37 is only 4 s/km faster than M pace 5:41 and each 200m lasts 67.4 s. Full 169 s walking is 2.51x work duration. This is easy/M rhythm presented as repetition sharpness; numeric session/description/prediction coherence passes.

findings.expected: Reduce quality dose alongside volume in the first taper week; retain useful rhythm without making the taper week a larger quality stimulus.
findings.actual: Old total quality increases 47.58 min in W 17 to 49.57 min in W 18 while volume falls 42.1to 34.6 km. M dose increases 4.8to 6 km. New drops 32.09to 27.17 min while 49.1to 39.3 km, then 14.21 min/31.9 km in W 19.

findings.expected: A conservative return should retain honest uncertainty and make the race-date/endurance mismatch actionable before the timed marathon is treated as a supported outcome.
findings.actual: Confirmed 14-day break resets base 30to 21 km, LR 10to 7 km and future full-week peak to 29 km. Longest future LR 8.8 km (~52 min), then race 42.195 km (~4.79x). Build succeeds, preserves 4 h goal and race date, and flags endurance-limited plus no readiness confirmation. No unsafe growth or false readiness invariant failed; delivered preparation is substantially weaker than even the limited frozen plan.

findings.expected: Warnings should describe the guarded, grafted delivered plan and the effective confirmed-return easy period consistently.
findings.actual: Warning says 1 easy return week while explicit confirmed-return note says 3 initial weeks without quality (three generated calendar weeks include the partial Nov 23 week). Other warnings quote peakLR 9.1 km/weekly 29.9 km while final remaining preparation is 8.8 km/29 km after guard/graft. The final preparation object is correct but dayWarnings retain upstream figures.

Raw version identity visible; not a blinded review.
All40 frozen weeks and all20 adjusted stored weeks reviewed; UI centrally owned byU06.
Production new-domain return only; no old return API parity asserted.
Manual/measured/early-done/moved protection challenge is separately seeded; it is not primary execution history.
Time on feet estimates use prescribed LR pace357s/km, not measured run duration.
